task.title: Content branch
task.body:
Repositories that keep tasks, wiki, settings or pull requests on Genbeya's content branch work as on desktop. See [[Architecture#clones-on-a-phone]].

- [ ] Fetch the content branch with the code branch; read each area where `.genbeya-content` says
- [ ] Edits to an area on the branch are committed onto it without a checkout
- [ ] Sync rebases and pushes the content branch too
- [ ] Tested against a repository whose layout was made by Genbeya desktop
